title: First Yahrzeit 5786
description: An evening of remembering Rav Ebner at the Ramban Shul in Jerusalem, with speakers/shiurim by Mrs. Ebner, Rabbi Brovender, and other students and colleagues.

title: Tradition Tribute
description: Rabbi David Ebner zt”l was an educator who combined sensitivity, passion, and warmth with keen intellectual rigor and profound moral integrity. He taught for decades at Yeshivat HaMivtar, Michlelet Bruria, Yeshivat Eretz HaTzvi, and at ATID–WebYeshiva.org. Scores of his talmidim went on to become educators in their own right, furthering his influence to the next generation.
